📖 How to Read This Report

Daily Refresh Flow

The daily refresh now runs in this dependency order:

Daily refresh → Portfolio Strategy Lab → Sector Rotation → Stage 2 Tracker → Top Investment Picks Detailed Report → My Portfolio EOD Report.

Read this tracker after the strategy lab and sector rotation reports. The Best Strategy and VCP Strategy tabs are pulled from the latest strategy-lab run, while the Stage 2 tables use the latest PostgreSQL stage snapshot.

Recommended Reading Order

1. Summary cards — confirm Stage 2 breadth, daily exits, and stage transition pressure.

2. Best Strategy tab — see which paper strategy currently leads and which open positions it owns.

3. VCP Strategy tab — inspect the VCP strategy result separately, even when it is not the top-ranked strategy.

4. Stage 2 Now — scan all current Stage 2 names using the RS-weighted Signal, Supertrend, RS, and Investment Score.

5. Top Investment Picks report — use the independent detailed report for charts, entry/stop/target context, fundamentals, events, and risk notes.

🏗 Weinstein Stage Method

Stage 1 – Basing
Price moves sideways, SMA50 flattening. Stock consolidating after decline. Watch for breakout.

Stage 2 ✅ – Advancing
Price above SMA50 & SMA200, both rising. Best risk/reward for new positions.

Stage 3 – Topping
Price stalls near highs, SMA50 flattening. Tighten stops or exit.

Stage 4 ❌ – Declining
Price below SMA50 & SMA200, both falling. Avoid.

📊 RSI (Relative Strength Index)

< 30 — Oversold (potential reversal up)

30–50 — Weak / recovering

50–70 ✅ — Bullish momentum

> 70 — Overbought (watch for pullback)

📈 Relative Strength (RS)

Price performance vs Nifty 500 over 12 months. Positive RS = outperforming the index.

⚡ Supertrend (ATR-based)

Period = 10, Multiplier = 3. Uses Average True Range (ATR) to set dynamic support/resistance bands.

↑ BULLISH — Price above supertrend band (green support). Trend is up — trailing stop holds.

↓ BEARISH — Price below supertrend band (red resistance). Trend has reversed down.

📡 Trend Signal

STRONG_BULLISH — Both SMA50 & SMA200 rising, price above both.

BULLISH — Price above SMA50.

NEUTRAL — Mixed signals.

BEARISH — Price below SMA50 and/or SMA200.

🎯 Stage 2 Signal Score (0–100)

The displayed Signal for Stage 2 rows is weighted toward market leadership:

Technical Score 35% RS vs Nifty 500 25% VCP / Minervini 20% Fund Score 15% Trend 5%

Negative RS is capped below BUY, so a Stage 2 stock must outperform Nifty 500 to receive BUY or STRONG_BUY.

🏆 Investment Score (0–100)

Composite metric combining:

Technical Score 30% Fund Score 25% Relative Strength 15% Stage Score 15% RSI Optimality 15%

🔬 Technical Score (0–100)

Composite of: RSI momentum · Supertrend direction · SMA trend alignment · 1W/1M price momentum · Distance from 52-week high · Relative Strength vs index.

📋 Fundamental Metrics

Enhanced Fund Score — Quality-adjusted earnings + growth composite.

Earnings Quality — Consistency and reliability of profits.

Sales Growth — Revenue growth trajectory.

Financial Strength — Debt/equity, interest coverage, cash flow.

Institutional Backing — FII/DII ownership trend.

CAN SLIM Score — O'Neil's criteria: EPS growth, RS, New highs, etc.

Minervini Score — Trend template: price > SMA50 > SMA150 > SMA200.

🔄 Stage Transitions

S1 → S2 ↑  Stock just entered uptrend — high-priority watchlist entry.

S2 → S3 ↓  Stage 2 stock showing topping signs — consider tightening stops or exiting.
